input.rationale: Article VIX is a pure disclaimer: the Licensed Technology is provided "AS IS", all warranties "WHETHER EXPRESS OR IMPLIED" are disclaimed, and Licensor expressly does not warrant that nonconformity to the Documentation "CAN OR WILL BE CORRECTED." There is no affirmative performance or conformity warranty anywhere in the Agreement (the only other "warrants" references are Licensee-side or boilerplate representations at p0159). This sits at the playbook walk-away position. Redline inserts a limited warranty (workmanlike services, 12-month conformity to Documentation, compliance with laws, no malicious code) with a repair/replace/refund remedy and carves that express warranty out of the disclaimer so it is not swallowed; fallback is a 90-day conformity period.

proposal.summary: Add express performance/conformity warranty with repair-replace-refund remedy and carve it out of the AS IS disclaimer
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article VIX currently disclaims all warranties, express and implied, so we have no recourse if the Licensed Technology does not work as documented. We have added a limited warranty (workmanlike services, 12-month conformity to Documentation, compliance with laws, no malicious code) with a repair/replace/refund remedy, and carved it out of the disclaimer; we can accept a 90-day conformity period if needed.
